checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must.why: One sneaker, but it is light grey suede/nubuck with white sole, collar and laces, not a white leather shoe.

must.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must.why: White background with faint mottling and a soft shadow; no props.

must.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe is in frame with margins.

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.
must.why: None visible, apart from a faint tiny mark on the tongue.

faults.what: Shoe body is grey suede, not white leather as the brief requires
Faint blotchy off-white patches in the background, not perfectly clean
Tiny illegible smudge text on the tongue

summary: A clean square three-quarter sneaker shot on near-white, but the shoe is grey suede rather than white leather.
